title: v2.principal.get_shop_affiliate_performance
label: SHOPEE · API REFERENCE
html:
{"content":"

Queries affiliate performance data for the specified shops within the selected time range. Supports request granularity by day, week, month, quarter, year, or customize, and returns both overall summary metrics and shop-level detailed metrics with placed-order and confirmed-order views.

","raw_content":[{"name":"paragraph","children":[{"data":"Queries affiliate performance data for the specified shops within the selected time range. Supports request granularity by day, week, month, quarter, year, or customize, and returns both overall summary metrics and shop-level detailed metrics with placed-order and confirmed-order views."}]}]}

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredSampleDescription
start_datestringTrue2026-01-01<p>Start date of the requested period in YYYY-MM-DD format.<br /><br />Limitations:<br /></p><p>- Must use the YYYY-MM-DD format.</p><p>- Must be a valid calendar date.</p><p>- Must not be later than end_date.</p><p>- Validation is based on the requested timezone.</p><p>- The earliest selectable date is calculated as: current day in timezone - 1 day - 2 years.</p><p>- The exact boundary rules depend on granularity:</p><p>-- For customize, start_date must not be earlier than the earliest selectable date.</p><p>-- For day, start_date must equal end_date.</p><p>-- For week, start_date must be a Sunday.</p><p>-- For month, start_date must be the first day of the month.</p><p>-- For quarter, start_date must be the first day of the quarter.</p><p>-- For year, start_date must be the first day of the year.</p>
end_datestringTrue2026-01-01<p>End date of the requested period in YYYY-MM-DD format.<br /><br />Limitations:<br /><br />- Must use the YYYY-MM-DD format.<br /><br />- Must be a valid calendar date.<br /><br />- Must not be earlier than start_date.<br /><br />- Validation is based on the requested timezone.<br /><br />- For customize, end_date must not be later than the day before the current day in the requested timezone. The inclusive date range from start_date to end_date must not exceed 366 days.<br /><br />- For day, end_date must equal start_date.<br /><br />- For week, end_date must be within the selected week range: from start_date (Sunday) to the end of that Sunday-to-Saturday week, or to the latest selectable day if the week extends beyond today. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(startDate + 6 days, today - 1 day).<br /><br />- For month, end_date must be within the selected month: from the 1st day of the month to the last calendar day of that month, or to the latest selectable day for the current month. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(month end, today - 1 day).<br /><br />- For quarter, end_date must be within the selected quarter: from the 1st day of the quarter to the last calendar day of that quarter, or to the latest selectable day for the current quarter. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(quarter end, today - 1 day).<br /><br />- For year, end_date must be within the selected year: from January 1st to December 31st of that year, or to the latest selectable day for the current year. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(Dec 31, today - 1 day).</p>
timezonestringTrueGMT+8<p>Timezone used for date boundary calculation, selectable date validation, and timestamp conversion.<br /><br /></p><p>Limitations:</p><p>- Enum values: [\"GMT+7\", \"GMT+8\", \"GMT-3\"]</p><p>- All date validation rules are evaluated in the requested timezone.</p>
granularitystringTrueday<p>Aggregation granularity that determines the validation rules for the requested date range and the reporting period.</p><p><br /></p><p>Limitations:</p><p>- Supported values are customize, day, week, month, quarter, and year.</p><p>- customize is validated as a free date range and is internally queried as daily data.</p><p>- day represents a single calendar day.</p><p>- week requires a Sunday-based calendar week.</p><p>- month requires a calendar month range.</p><p>- quarter requires a calendar quarter range.</p><p>- year requires a calendar year range.</p><p>- Any other value is rejected as invalid_parameter.</p>
shop_listobject[]False<p>List of shops to be queried. This field is optional. If omitted or passed as an empty array, the API will return data for all shops under the specified principal_id.<br />Limitations:<br />- If provided, must contain at most 50 shops.<br />- If omitted or passed as [], all shops under the specified principal_id will be queried.<br />- If provided as a non-empty array, all shops must belong to the specified principal_id.<br />Duplicate shops are not allowed.</p>
